theorems.name: Submission.sff_immersion_local_left_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (x₀ : Rn n), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ x₀ → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀) → ∃ g : Rn N → Rn n, DifferentiableAt ℝ g (ψ x₀) ∧ ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, g (ψ x) = x
